hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Every valid submatrix has its top-left corner fixed at (0, 0).

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: The sum of elements from (0, 0) to (r, c) is given by 2D prefix sums.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Compute running 2D prefix sums in-place or with an auxiliary matrix. Count coordinates (r, c) where pref[r][c] <= k.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Summing each submatrix from scratch takes O(R^2 * C^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 2D prefix sum inclusion-exclusion formula in O(R * C).
